description: Figure 16(c) illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for the MMLU Pro dataset, using the Llama-4-Scout model as the solver. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence," ranges from 0.81 to 0.99 and is marked with values at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot displays three distinct lines: "Final Accuracy" (blue, solid line with square markers), "Δ Accuracy" (orange, dashed line with triangle markers), and "Initial Accuracy" (green, dotted line with circle markers). The "Final Accuracy" line starts at approximately 1.0 at an initial confidence of 0.81 and remains high, fluctuating slightly around 0.95-1.0. The "Initial Accuracy" line begins at approximately 0.6 and shows a general upward trend, reaching a peak near 0.95 at an initial confidence of 0.99. The "Δ Accuracy" line starts at approximately 0.4, dips to a low of about 0.2 at an initial confidence of 0.85, and then rises to a peak of about 0.6 at an initial confidence of 0.91 before declining again.
